mapper.select: SELECT p.* FROM `t_completion_archive` p WHERE ORDER BY p.`archive_no`, p.`id`
SELECT p.* FROM `t_completion_archive` p WHERE ORDER BY p.`archive_no`, p.`id`

SELECT COUNT(1) AS `total`, SUM(CASE WHEN p.`archive_id` IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS `archivedCount`, SUM(CASE WHEN p.`digitize_status` = '已数字化' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS `digitizedCount`, COALESCE(SUM(p.`page_count`), 0) AS `pageTotal`, COALESCE(SUM(p.`file_count`), 0) AS `fileTotal`, COALESCE(SUM(p.`invest_amount`), 0) AS `investTotal` FROM `t_completion_archive` p WHERE
SELECT p.`digitize_status` AS `status`, COUNT(1) AS `count` FROM `t_completion_archive` p WHERE GROUP BY p.`digitize_status` ORDER BY `count` DESC

SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(p.`${column}`, ''), #{emptyLabel}) AS `name`, COUNT(1) AS `count` FROM `t_completion_archive` p WHERE GROUP BY COALESCE(NULLIF(p.`${column}`, ''), #{emptyLabel}) ORDER BY `count` DESC

SELECT SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(p.`archive_no`, '-', 2), '-', -1) AS `name`, COUNT(1) AS `count` FROM `t_completion_archive` p WHERE p.`archive_no` LIKE 'JG-%' AND GROUP BY SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(p.`archive_no`, '-', 2), '-', -1) ORDER BY `name`

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(p.`complete_date`, '%Y') AS `name`, COUNT(1) AS `count` FROM `t_completion_archive` p WHERE p.`complete_date` IS NOT NULL AND GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(p.`complete_date`, '%Y') ORDER BY `name`

SELECT MAX(CAST(SUBSTRING(p.`archive_no`, CHAR_LENGTH(#{prefix}) + 1) AS UNSIGNED)) FROM `t_completion_archive` p WHERE p.`archive_no` LIKE CONCAT(#{prefix}, '%') AND CHAR_LENGTH(p.`archive_no`) = CHAR_LENGTH(#{prefix}) + 4
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM `t_archive` a WHERE a.`del_flag` = 0 AND a.`id` = #{archiveId}
